purpose: Research links for four exact newsroom events; not a source provider, not a publication license or human fact-check

selected_events.exact_news_title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn

primary_documents.issuer: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
required_phrases: The Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate
Voting against the monetary policy action were Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack

selected_events.counterevidence_search: The two FOMC members favoring a hike; separate actual inflation series from market forecasts
selected_events.causal_mechanism_to_test: Policy-rate decision -> expectations / term premia -> credit conditions; requires market and data measurements, not title inference

selected_events.exact_news_title: German Consumers Grow Slightly Gloomier on Lingering Inflation Concerns

primary_documents.issuer: Nuremberg Institute for Market Decisions (NIM), Consumer Climate powered by GfK
required_phrases: declines slightly by 0.2 points to -30.8 points
economic expectations are rising for the sixth consecutive month
willingness to buy continues to decline slightly

selected_events.counterevidence_search: Survey economic expectations improving even as composite consumer climate softens
selected_events.causal_mechanism_to_test: Survey attitudes -> subsequent consumer spending; requires methodology and official sales data; correlation is not causation

selected_events.exact_news_title: Growth Plays Key Supporting Role in Bank of Canada Rate-Hike Decision
selected_events.research_subject: Bank of Canada 2026-10-28 rate increase and outlook

required_phrases: increased its target for the overnight rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%
Growth picked up in Canada through the middle of the year
Given persistently high oil prices, CPI inflation has been around 3%

primary_documents.issuer: Bank of Canada, governor press conference
required_phrases: The main argument for holding was that the rise in inflation
The main argument for an increase was that energy prices are higher

selected_events.counterevidence_search: Governor explicitly discusses the option of holding; inflation excluding gasoline and economic slack require comparison
selected_events.causal_mechanism_to_test: Energy cost increases -> input costs -> passthrough -> CPI and monetary policy response; test with official forecast and survey series

selected_events.exact_news_title: Tanzania celebrates first natural gas discovery in more than 10 years
selected_events.research_subject: Mnazi Bay Kasa-1X discovery: reported 223 Bcf versus operator preliminary ~200 Bcf

primary_documents.issuer: Maurel & Prom (operator; primary technical corporate release)
required_phrases: confirmed the presence of a gas reservoir with encouraging characteristics
120 bcf on an M&P working interest basis
primary_documents.locator_hint: PDF page 4 (zero-based page 3), Tanzania subsection; volume estimates are preliminary gas volumes and not independently certified reserves

selected_events.counterevidence_search: Compare dated government estimate 223 Bcf, operator preliminary approximately 200 Bcf gross, and resource classification before calling it reserves
selected_events.causal_mechanism_to_test: Gas-in-place estimates -> proven recoverable resources -> infrastructure/time to first production -> actual electricity/industrial price impact; requires field/transport data
